en: A monochrome historic postcard showing a gently rising street lined with multi‑story townhouses and shops. In the foreground are early 20th‑century European buildings, including a corner shop with a large sign reading "PHOTOGRAPHIE." Pedestrians and a few carts are visible on the street. In the distance, two tall Gothic church spires dominate the skyline. The lower margin bears handwritten captions indicating the town and the street name.
